answer: Adversarial expansion is constrained by an escalating marginal cost curve; non-refundable attestation fees and staked collateral function as a structural cipher, encoding identity fabrication costs into the security primitive. As the Sybil vine propagates, latent opportunity costs and slashing penalties drive expected utility into negative territory. This forces every isolated island of malicious compute toward a robust Nash equilibrium, as cumulative capital required to sustain the attack mathematically exceeds all protocol gains.
